answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 11256 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it permitted to have sex in the shower/ tub for lust?? or are their any restrictions on this act?? Question: Is it permitted to have sex in the shower/ tub for lust?? or are their any restrictions on this act?? Answer ID: 11256 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 459/459 =M/1430) It is prohibited in hadith to be completely nude while having sex; since it is obscenity and shamelessness. If the question is related to intercourse in shower and tub in the same condition, then it is better to avoid it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
